remarks: Modern High-Rise Living in the Heart of Stamford - Prime Bedford Street Location! Welcome to this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo in one of Stamford's most desirable high-rise buildings, located right on Bedford Street in the vibrant heart of downtown! This unit combines modern living with unmatched convenience, offering the best of both comfort and city life. Step inside to a completely remodeled kitchen, featuring sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and updated cabinetry-perfect for preparing meals at home or entertaining guests. The open layout is bright and airy, with large windows that bring in natural light and offer a warm, inviting atmosphere. Enjoy your own private balcony, ideal for relaxing or enjoying the city views. This home also includes a rare, dedicated covered parking space located in the back of the building , making it incredibly convenient-especially in a bustling downtown area. Outside your door, the best of Stamford awaits: award-winning restaurants, cozy cafes, boutique shopping, seasonal events, and family-friendly entertainment, all just steps away. Whether you're heading out for a casual dinner, enjoying live music, or taking a stroll through nearby parks, you'll love being in the center of it all. This stunning High rise condo is perfect for anyone seeking a stylish and low-maintenance home in a highly walkable, accessible and vibrant neighborhood-this is downtown Stamford living at its finest.
